description: This file defines the 'Record' class in Java, which manages record data including fields, field accessors, and serialization/deserialization logic for fixed and delimited file formats within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: Represents a data record with fields, supporting serialization, parsing, and writing operations for fixed-length and delimited data formats as used in file processing within OFBiz.

methods.name: getRecordName
methods.description: Returns the name of the record.

methods.name: getModelRecord
methods.description: Returns the associated ModelRecord object which defines the structure of the record.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field by name.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a field's value.

methods.name: getStringAndEmpty
methods.description: Returns the string value of a field or empty string if null.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp value of a field.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves the time value of a field.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date value of a field.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value of a field.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves the long value of a field.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves the float value of a field.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves the double value of a field.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field value by name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field value with control over null handling.

methods.name: readLEShort
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 2-byte short from a byte array.

methods.name: readLEInt
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte int from a byte array.

methods.name: readLELong
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 8-byte long from a byte array.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Parses and sets a field value from a string based on its type.

methods.name: getFixedString
methods.description: Returns a fixed-length string representation of a field's value.

methods.name: writeLineString
methods.description: Serializes the record into a string line for output, supporting fixed-length and delimited formats.

methods.name: padFrontZeros
methods.description: Pads a string with leading zeros to a specified total length.

methods.name: getParentRecord
methods.description: Returns the parent record if any.

methods.name: getChildRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of child records.

methods.name: addChildRecord
methods.description: Adds a child record to this record.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Creates a new Record instance given a ModelRecord.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Creates a new Record with specified fields from a Map.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Creates a Record from a line string, parsing based on the model definition and line number.

methods.name: createDelimitedRecord
methods.description: Creates a Record from a delimited string line, parsing based on the model definition, delimiter, and line number.
